Reports uncovered statements / branches / functions for a source file from coverage/coverage-final.json. Coordinates are transformed-space; use the --source-map decode when the JSX transformer emits maps.

Reads every module's reports/coverage/coverage-final.json (per-module reports — see shared/tests/jest.preset.mjs) and searches them all.
